<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
        const hiddenField = document.querySelector('#field-5');
        
        if (!hiddenField) {
            console.error("Скрытое поле с данными не найдено!");
            return;
        }
        
        // 2. Забираем его значение (JSON-строку)
        const jsonDataString = hiddenField.value;
        
        // 3. Превращаем строку обратно в объект
        const data = JSON.parse(jsonDataString);
      
        document.querySelector("#field-0").value = data.url || "";
        document.querySelector("#field-1").value = data.name || "";
        document.querySelector("#field-2").value = data.source_type || "";
              // Обрабатываем чекбоксы для source_type
        const trueCheckbox = document.querySelector("#option0_field-3");
        const falseCheckbox = document.querySelector("#option1_field-3");
        if (data.is_active === true) {
            trueCheckbox.checked = true;
        } else {
            falseCheckbox.checked = true;
        }
    });
</script>

parameters.query:
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.name,
  c.platform,

  -- объект для дефолтного профиля TOV
  CASE
    WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL THEN
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', t.id,
        'profile_name', t.profile_name,
        'style', t.style,
        'length_preference', t.length_preference,
        'use_emojis', t.use_emojis
      )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS default_tov,

  -- массив всех tov_rules, связанных через tov_rule_channels
  COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      DISTINCT jsonb_build_object(
        'id', tr.id,
        'name', tr.name,
        'content_type', tr.content_type,
        'keywords', tr.keywords,
        'priority', tr.priority,
        'tov_profile', jsonb_build_object(
          'id', tv.id,
          'profile_name', tv.profile_name,
          'style', tv.style,
          'length_preference', tv.length_preference,
          'use_emojis', tv.use_emojis
        )
      )
    ) FILTER (WHERE tr.id IS NOT NULL),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS tov_rules

FROM public.channels AS c
LEFT JOIN public.tone_of_voice_profiles AS t
  ON c.default_tov_id = t.id

-- связи между каналами и правилами
LEFT JOIN public.tov_rule_channels AS trc
  ON c.id = trc.channel_id

-- сами правила
LEFT JOIN public.tov_rules AS tr
  ON trc.rule_id = tr.id

-- связанные tone_of_voice профили для правил
LEFT JOIN public.tone_of_voice_profiles AS tv
  ON tr.tov_id = tv.id

WHERE c.id = '{{ $('Callback').item.json.value }}'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.platform, t.id, t.profile_name, t.style, t.length_preference, t.use_emojis;

SELECT
  c.id,
  c.name,
  c.platform,
  CASE 
    WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'id', t.id,
      'profile_name', t.profile_name,
      'style', t.style,
      'length_preference', t.length_preference,
      'use_emojis', t.use_emojis
    )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS default_ToV
FROM public.channels AS c
LEFT JOIN public.tone_of_voice_profiles AS t
  ON c.default_tov_id = t.id;

-- 1. Удаляем связи старых правил
DELETE FROM tov_rule_channels
WHERE channel_id = '{{ $json.channel_id }}'
  AND rule_id = ANY(ARRAY[{{ $json.removedRules.map(r => `'${r.id}'`).join(', ') || 'NULL' }}]::uuid[]);

-- 2. Добавляем новые связи (если есть)
INSERT INTO tov_rule_channels (channel_id, rule_id)
SELECT '{{ $json.channel_id }}', x.id::uuid
FROM jsonb_to_recordset('{{ JSON.stringify($json.addedRules || []) }}'::jsonb)
AS x(id text)
WHERE x.id IS NOT NULL;

-- 3. Добавляем новые правила (если есть)
INSERT INTO tov_rules (name, tov_id, content_type, keywords, priority)
SELECT name, tov_id::uuid, content_type, keywords, priority
FROM jsonb_to_recordset('{{ JSON.stringify($json.newRules || []) }}'::jsonb)
AS x(name text, tov_id text, content_type text, keywords text[], priority int)
WHERE x.name IS NOT NULL;

-- 4. Привязываем вновь добавленные правила к каналу
INSERT INTO tov_rule_channels (channel_id, rule_id)
SELECT '{{ $json.channel_id }}', id
FROM tov_rules
WHERE name IN (
  SELECT name FROM jsonb_to_recordset('{{ JSON.stringify($json.newRules || []) }}'::jsonb)
  AS x(name text)
);

SELECT
  tr.id,
  tr.name,
  tr.content_type,
  tr.keywords,
  tr.priority,

  -- Создаем вложенный JSON-объект для профиля ToV, как и раньше
  jsonb_build_object(
    'id', tv.id,
    'profile_name', tv.profile_name,
    'style', tv.style,
    'length_preference', tv.length_preference,
    'use_emojis', tv.use_emojis
  ) AS tov_profile

FROM
  public.tov_rules AS tr

-- Используем INNER JOIN, так как нам нужны только те правила, что связаны с каналами
JOIN
  public.tov_rule_channels AS trc ON tr.id = trc.rule_id

-- Присоединяем профили, чтобы получить детали ToV для каждого правила
JOIN
  public.tone_of_voice_profiles AS tv ON tr.tov_id = tv.id

WHERE
  -- Фильтруем по ID канала в связующей таблице
  trc.channel_id = '{{ $('Callback').item.json.value }}';

SELECT
  tr.id,
  tr.name,
  tr.content_type,
  tr.keywords,
  tr.priority,
  COUNT(trc) AS count_chennels
FROM
  public.tov_rules AS tr
LEFT JOIN
  public.tov_rule_channels AS trc ON tr.id = trc.rule_id
GROUP BY(
  tr.id,
  tr.name,
  tr.content_type,
  tr.keywords,
  tr.priority
  )

SELECT
  tr.id,
  tr.name,
  tr.content_type,
  tr.keywords,
  tr.priority,
  tv.id AS tov_id,
  tv.profile_name AS tov_profile_name
FROM
  public.tov_rules AS tr
JOIN
  public.tone_of_voice_profiles AS tv ON tr.tov_id = tv.id
WHERE
  tr.id = '{{ $('Callback').item.json.value }}';

SELECT
  t.*, -- Selects all fields from the topics table

  -- Builds a JSON array of objects with only the specified fields from the source articles
  (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'url', c.url,
        'title', c.title,
        'body', c.body
      )
    )
    FROM public.contents AS c
    WHERE c.id = ANY(t.source_content_ids)
  ) AS source_contents,

  -- Builds a full JSON object for the Tone of Voice profile
  (
    SELECT to_jsonb(tv)
    FROM public.tone_of_voice_profiles AS tv
    WHERE tv.id = t.tov_id
  ) AS tov_profile

FROM
  public.topics t

WHERE
  -- Finds the required topic by its ID from the incoming data
  t.id = '{{ $json.topic_id }}';

SELECT
    d.id AS draft_id,
    d.topic_id,
    d.headline,
    d.body,
    d.status AS draft_status,
    d.created_at AS draft_created_at,

    -- Все поля темы
    t.id AS topic_id,
    t.created_at AS topic_created_at,
    t.title AS topic_title,
    t.why_it_matters,
    t.hook,
    t.status AS topic_status,
    t.source_content_ids,
    t.tov_id,
    t.suggested_channel_ids

FROM public.drafts AS d

-- Соединяем с темой
LEFT JOIN public.topics AS t
    ON d.topic_id = t.id

WHERE d.status IN ('draft', 'review')
  AND d.created_at >= (now() - interval '{{ $('Data').item.json.statuses.time_trigger }} day')
  AND d.created_at < now()
ORDER BY d.created_at DESC;

INSERT INTO public.active_draft (draft_id, headline, body)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.id }}',  -- ID можно оставить в одинарных кавычках, он безопасен
  $${{ $json.headline }}$$,  -- А вот текст оборачиваем в $$
  $${{ $json.body }}$$
)
ON CONFLICT (draft_id)
DO UPDATE SET
  headline = EXCLUDED.headline,
  body = EXCLUDED.body;
